integrity: The first-public date is the arXiv v1 date printed on arXiv:1602.00291v1, 31 January 2016. That primary source lists AMS 05C12, 05C76, and 05C90; 05C12 is used as the primary classification here. The proof does not depend on computational extrapolation or on the later extremal bipartite classification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite half graphs \(H_p\) with \(p\ge2\), not arbitrary chain graphs with repeated twin classes. The exhaustive computation through order \(18\) is corroborative only; the general theorem rests on the structural proof. Literature searches cannot exclude an obscure equivalent statement under substantially different terminology.
title: Edge metric bases of half graphs
